chunks: Muhammad b. Umar al-Hafiz al-Baghdadi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Hafs narrated to me. He said: Muhammad b. Harun Abu Ishaq al-Hashimi al-Mansuri narrated to me. He said: al-Qasim b. al-Husayn al-Zubaydi narrated to us. He said: Yahya b. Abd al-Hamid narrated to us. He said: Qays b. al-Rabi narrated to us from Abu Harun from Abu Sa'id.

He said: On the Day of Ghadir Khumm, the Messenger of God, peace be upon him and his family, ordered a caller to call out for congregational prayer. Then he took the hand of Ali, peace be upon him, and said: O God! To whomever I am a master, Ali is his master. O God! Be a friend to whoever befriends him and an enemy to whoever opposes him.
Then Hassan b. Thabit said: O Messenger of God, shall I recite a poem about Ali? The Messenger of God, peace be upon him and his family, said to him: Do so. So he said:

Their Prophet calls them on the Day of Ghadir / At Khumm, and how honoured is the Prophet as a caller / He says: Who is your master and your guardian? / They said, showing no hostility there: / Your God is our Master and you are our guardian / And you will never find among us a disobedient one today / Then he said to him: Stand, O Ali, for indeed I / Am pleased with you as an Imam and a guide after me / Then Ali stood, suffering from conjunctivitis / Seeking a cure for his eyes from his complaint / Then the best of people cured him with his saliva / So blessed is the one cured and blessed is the healer.

key_terms.إماما وهاديا: An Imam and a guide — titles of divinely ordained leadership
key_terms.غدير خم: Ghadir Khumm — a location between Mecca and Medina where the Prophet made his declaration
key_terms.من كنت مولاه فعلي مولاه: To whomever I am a master, Ali is his master — the central declaration of Ghadir
key_terms.مولاه: His master/patron — the key term in the Ghadir declaration, denoting authority and guardianship
key_terms.وال من والاه وعاد من عاداه: Be a friend to whoever befriends him and an enemy to whoever opposes him — the Prophet's supplication following the declaration

ai.seo_question: What happened at Ghadir Khumm when the Prophet declared Ali as his successor?
ai.summary: This hadith records the event of Ghadir Khumm, where the Prophet Muhammad designated Ali b. Abi Talib as his successor before the Muslim community. After the Farewell Pilgrimage, the Prophet stopped at Ghadir Khumm, called the people to congregational prayer, took Ali's hand, and declared the famous words 'To whomever I am a master, Ali is his master.' The poet Hassan b. Thabit, the Prophet's official poet, then asked and received permission to compose a poem commemorating the event, which included the Prophet's appointment of Ali as Imam and guide, and the miraculous healing of Ali's eye affliction with the Prophet's saliva.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Umar al-Hafith al-Baghdadi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Hafs narrated to me. He said: Muhammad b. Harun Abu Ishaq al-Hamadani al-Mansuri narrated to me. He said: Al-Qasim b. al-Husayn al-Zubaydi narrarted to us He said: Yahya b `Abd al-Hamid narrated to us He said: Qays b. al-Rabi` narrated to us from Abi Harun from Abi Sa`id.

He said: On the Day of Ghadir Khumm, the Messenger of Allah (s) ordered a caller to call out for a congregational prayer. Then, he took the hand of `Ali (as) and said: O Allah! To whomever I am a Master, `Ali is his Master. O Allah! Align with those who align with him and oppose those who oppose him.
Then, Hassan b. Thabit said: O Messenger of Allah! Shall I recite a poem about `Ali? So, the Messenger of Allah (s) said: Do so.

So, he said: Their Prophet calls them on the Day of Ghadir In Khumm, the Prophet was graced with a caller who said:  “Who is your Master and your Ally?” So, they said, without any hostility there: “Your God is our Master, and you are our Ally, And you will not find us disobedient to you.” So, he said to him: “Stand, `Ali, for I am pleased with you as an Imam and a guide after me.” `Ali stood ill with eye conjunctivitis, Seeking treatment for his complaint, Then the best of people cured him with a prayer, So, blessed is the cured and the curer.
